GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 366.7 (4 Dec 45) ESS-FI
(SCAPIN-388)
APO 500
4 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : THE IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Imperial Household Department.
It is directed that the Imperial Japanese Government advice this Headquarters as to what agency or department of the Imperial Japanese Government is responsible for insuring compliance by the Imperial Household Department with directives issued by this Headquarters.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
